title: The Master Mind Map
subtitle: The whole record as one tree of light
card_blurb: The whole record in one map. Every being, every mechanism and every hidden turn of the realm, gathered from the original transmissions into a single tree of 437 nodes. Each node opens into its own full report. Start at the root and follow the branches. This is the Great Remembering, drawn whole.
description:
The record does not arrive in order. It comes scattered across hundreds of transmissions: a being named once in one place, a mechanism explained in another, a history split across a dozen tellings. The full picture only appears when those pieces are gathered back into one shape.

This map is that shape. One root branches into the eleven main limbs below, and from those limbs grow 437 nodes, so every subject the transmissions touch has its own place on the tree.

Every node is a doorway. Behind each one is a full report on what it is, how it works, how it connects to everything else, and what it means for those waking up now.

The map is alive and still growing. New reports open branch by branch as the record fills in, and topics on the way are shown so you can see where it's heading. Start at the root, or step in anywhere and follow the connections. Every path leads back to the same remembering, so you know what happened and are ready when the events begin.
